name: quarter
description: Reference quarter of the observation, from 1 to 4
observations: Derived from the ABS mid-quarter month: February is quarter 1, May is 2, August is 3 and November is 4.

name: month
description: Reference month of the observation, from 1 to 12
observations: The ABS mid-quarter month, always February, May, August or November.

name: industry_division_code
description: ANZSIC 2006 division letter, from A to S
observations: Not published in the cube: attached from the ANZSIC (2006) Rev.2.0 division list, asserted to cover every observed label. In employment_industry, where the cube publishes group-level codes, the division is derived from the group code's ANZSIC subdivision (its first two digits), and directly from the letter for the 19 division-level nfd residuals.
original_name: Industry division of main job: ANZSIC (2006) Rev.2.0

name: industry_division
description: ANZSIC 2006 division of the main job
observations: ANZSIC (2006) Rev.2.0, carried by ABS across the whole history of the cube. A dedicated ANZSIC directory does not exist yet in br_bd_diretorios_au and is future work.
original_name: Industry division of main job: ANZSIC (2006) Rev.2.0

name: hours_measure
description: Hours concept the band applies to: hours usually worked in all jobs, hours actually worked in main job, or hours usually worked in main job
observations: Carries the concept that distinguished ABS cubes EQ10, EQ11 and EQ14, which share an identical grain and measure block. The four cube-specific zero labels are normalised to a single Did not work (0 hours) because this column now carries the concept.

name: hours_band
description: Range of hours worked in the reference week
observations: The hours concept the band applies to is given by the accompanying hours measure, where present.
original_name: Hours usually worked in all jobs / Hours actually worked in main job / Hours usually worked in main job

name: employed_full_time
observations: Converted from ABS thousands to absolute persons

name: employed_part_time
observations: Converted from ABS thousands to absolute persons

name: hours_worked_full_time
description: Total hours worked by persons employed full-time, on the hours concept given by hours_measure
observations: Converted from ABS thousands of hours to hours

name: hours_worked_part_time
description: Total hours worked by persons employed part-time, on the hours concept given by hours_measure
observations: Converted from ABS thousands of hours to hours
